Über den offenen Landschaften Nordamerik: It circles widely over the open landscapes of North America, watching for prey.
Offene Landschaften, Felder und Waldränd: Open landscapes, fields and woodland edges. Tall trees and posts serve as perches.
Ein wendiger Jäger, der seine Beute zwis: An agile hunter that surprises its prey among trees and from cover.
Wälder mit alten Bäumen und strukturreic: Woodland with old trees and richly structured woodland edges. In cities it also settles in large parks, cemeteries and green courtyards with mature trees.
Über Wiesen kreisend oder auf einem Zaun: Circling over meadows or waiting on a fence post: our familiar mouse hunter.
Wiesen, Weiden und Felder nahe an Wälder: Meadows, pastures and fields close to woods or groups of trees. There it finds hunting grounds and nesting sites.
Ein spezialisierter Vogeljäger, der sein: A specialist bird hunter that pursues its prey in open airspace.
Felswände, Küsten und Steinbrüche. In St: Cliffs, coasts and quarries. In cities it uses tall buildings as nesting sites.
Im Rüttelflug steht er scheinbar still ü: Hovering, it seems to stand still above the field as it scans the ground for mice.
Offene Felder, Wiesen und Siedlungen. Br: Open fields, meadows and settlements. Breeds in rock niches, on buildings and in nest boxes.
Mit ausgebreiteten Schwingen gleitet er: With outspread wings it glides along mountain slopes, using the rising air.
Offene Gebirgslandschaften und Felsregio: Open mountain landscapes and rocky regions. In Germany mainly in the Alps.
Über Seen und Küsten patrouilliert diese: This mighty bird of prey patrols lakes and coasts on its broad wings.
Große Seen, Flüsse und Küsten mit alten: Large lakes, rivers and coasts with old trees for the eyrie and undisturbed retreats.
Er sucht über dem Wasser nach Fischen un: It searches for fish over the water and seizes them with outstretched talons.
Fischreiche Seen, Flüsse und Küsten. Brü: Lakes, rivers and coasts rich in fish. Breeds in tall trees, on pylons and on special nesting platforms.
Von einem erhöhten Ansitz beobachtet er: From a raised perch it watches the ground and waits for a good opportunity. When it spots prey, it glides down and seizes it with outstretched talons.
Er nähert sich möglichst ungesehen zwisc: It approaches as unseen as possible between trees, hedges or buildings. With a short, fast attack it takes its prey by surprise.
Ein Pfahl oder eine Baumkrone bietet ihm: A post or treetop gives it a good view over the hunting ground. As soon as a mouse appears, it swoops down to the ground.
Er verfolgt fliegende Vögel oder nähert: It pursues flying birds or approaches them in a fast stoop from great height. It seizes or strikes its prey with its talons in mid-air.
Mit schnellen Flügelschlägen und gefäche: With rapid wingbeats and a fanned tail it holds its position above the ground. When it spots a mouse, it drops into a targeted strike.
Im Gleitflug sucht er offene Hänge und B: In gliding flight it searches open slopes and ridges for prey. It usually strikes on the ground, often using the cover of the terrain.
Von einem Ansitz oder im Suchflug hält e: From a perch or in search flight it looks out for fish and waterbirds. It often takes fish near the surface; waterbirds it also catches after a longer chase.
Er sucht im Flug nach Fischen nahe der W: It searches in flight for fish near the water surface. When attacking, it thrusts its talons forward and plunges feet-first into the water.

Jagt überwiegend nachts und in der Dämme: Hunts mainly at night and at dusk. Its acute hearing helps it locate hidden small mammals. By day it often roosts in buildings; its call is a harsh screech.
Brütet in geschützten Gebäudenischen, Ba: Breeds in sheltered niches in buildings, tree holes and nest boxes. The female starts incubating early, so young of different ages grow up together. They fledge after about eight weeks.
Sehr breite Flügel mit hellen Decken und: Very broad wings with pale coverts and dark flight feathers; short tail and a small head drawn in during flight. Adults have a pale neck ruff, juveniles a brown one.
Er nutzt Aufwinde für ausgedehnte Suchfl: It uses updrafts for long search flights. Many vultures often gather at carcasses, settling their places with threat displays and harsh calls.
Brütet meist in Kolonien auf geschützten: Usually breeds in colonies on sheltered rock ledges. Both parents incubate for about 52–58 days and feed the chick for several months.

Das Paar baut einen großen Asthorst in e: The pair builds a large stick nest in a tree near the water and often uses it for years. The young hatch after about 45 days; both parents help to feed them.
Breite Flügel, langer Schwanz und ein he: Broad wings, a long tail and a pale body between dark underwing coverts. The terminal tail band is broad in adults and still indistinct in juveniles.
Paare besetzen feste Reviere; Jungvögel: Pairs hold permanent territories; after leaving the parental territory, young birds roam widely.
Der Asthorst liegt meist in einer Felswa: The stick nest is usually on a cliff, regionally in a tree. Incubation lasts about 37–40 days; the young fledge after around two months.
Rechteckige Flügel, kräftiger Schnabel u: Rectangular wings, a strong bill and, in adult plumage, white shoulders. Juveniles are a warm rufous-brown and coloured quite differently from young Eastern Imperial Eagles.
Die Altvögel halten ganzjährig am Revier: Adults keep to their territory all year round. Young birds wander more widely while searching for suitable habitat.
Beide Partner bauen den großen Baumhorst: Both partners build the large tree nest. The young hatch after an incubation period of about 44 days; they spend roughly eleven weeks in the nest.
Schwarzer Altvogel mit weißem Rücken-V u: Black adult with a white V on the back, white rump and pale wing windows. The wings are strikingly narrow at the base; juveniles are mainly brown.
Pairs use the updrafts of steep slopes. Established adults stay faithful to their cliff territory, while young birds disperse.
Ein großer Asthorst wird meist auf einem: A large stick nest is usually built on a rock ledge. Often only the older chick survives. The nestling period lasts roughly three months.
Etwa bussardgroß, mit sechs deutlich gef: About the size of a buzzard, with six clearly fingered primaries and a relatively long tail. The pale morph shows a striking light–dark contrast; the dark morph is brown.
Europäische Brutvögel ziehen meist nach: European breeders mostly migrate to Africa. Pale and dark birds can pair with each other; the morphs are not subspecies.
Er baut den Horst überwiegend in hohen B: It builds its nest mainly in tall trees. The young hatch after about 37–40 days and leave the nest after around eight weeks.
Breite Flügel, ein gedrungener Körper un: Broad wings, a stocky body and a relatively short, rounded tail give the typical buzzard silhouette. Pale adults often show a dark belly band; juveniles still lack the red tail that gives the species its name.
Paare können über viele Jahre zusammenbl: Pairs can stay together for many years. In courtship they perform chases and steep flight manoeuvres. The territory, and especially the nest, is defended even against much larger raptors.
Beide Partner bauen oder erneuern den gr: Both partners build or repair the large stick nest, usually high in a tree. Rock ledges and structures are also used. After first leaving the nest, the young still depend on their parents for food.
Relativ kurze, breite Flügel und ein lan: Relatively short, broad wings and a long tail help it manoeuvre between trees. The pale supercilium is striking. Compared with the Eurasian Sparrowhawk, the goshawk is more powerfully built; females are clearly larger than males.
Der Habicht lebt häufig unauffällig in D: The goshawk often lives inconspicuously in cover. During courtship in late winter it becomes more visible with conspicuous flight displays. Established pairs are faithful to their territory and can use it for many years.
Der Horst liegt gewöhnlich in einer hohe: The nest is usually in a high fork of a tree. At about six weeks the young can fly, but they are fed for some time before leaving the parental territory.
Kompakter Körper, breite Flügel und ein: A compact body, broad wings and a short, fanned tail mark its flight silhouette. Plumage colour alone is not enough for identification: almost white, brown and very dark birds all belong to the same species.
Häufig sitzt er weithin sichtbar auf Pfä: It often perches conspicuously on posts or circles over its territory. In spring, mewing calls accompany its display flights. It needs open areas for foraging, even if the nest site is in woodland.
Den Asthorst errichtet das Paar in hohen: The pair builds its stick nest in tall trees such as oaks or pines, often at woodland edges. Suitable nests can be reused and repaired. Good access to prey nearby is crucial for raising the young.
Ein kräftiger Rumpf, spitze Flügel und e: A powerful body, pointed wings and a comparatively short tail distinguish it from slimmer falcons. The dark cap and broad moustachial stripe frame the pale cheek.
Der Wanderfalke verbindet schnelle Flüge: The Peregrine Falcon combines rapid wingbeats with glides. Pairs defend their nest site vigorously. Courtship includes joint flight manoeuvres; the bond to suitable cliffs or buildings can last a long time.
Er baut keinen Asthorst, sondern legt se: It builds no stick nest, but lays its eggs in a scraped hollow. Rock ledges and tall structures offer sheltered sites for this. The female does most of the incubating, while the male brings food.
Ein kleiner Falke mit spitzen Flügeln un: A small falcon with pointed wings and a long tail. In the male, the grey head and tail contrast with the rufous-brown back. Females and juveniles are mainly brown and more heavily barred.
Der Rüttelflug ist besonders auffällig:: Its hovering is particularly striking: with rapid wingbeats and a fanned tail it holds its position over a hunting area. Many adults stay in Central Europe in winter or move only short distances.
Felsnischen, Kirchtürme und andere Gebäu: Rock niches, church towers and other niches in buildings serve as nest sites. Special nest boxes are also accepted. Besides a sheltered nest site, an accessible open hunting area is essential for feeding the young.
Breite, deutlich gefingerte Flügel und e: Broad, clearly fingered wings and a relatively long tail characterise this large eagle. Golden-brown nape feathers are visible at close range. Juveniles often show conspicuous white patches in the wings and tail.
Über seinem Revier nutzt er Aufwinde für: Over its territory it uses updrafts for sustained soaring. In courtship, steep dives alternate with renewed climbs. Pairs can fly together and sometimes cooperate when hunting.
Felswände, örtlich auch große Bäume, tra: Cliffs, locally also large trees, carry the bulky nests. A pair may use several nests in turn and add to them over the years. The young spend many weeks in the nest before their first flight.
